markers.text: Most of the Nightmare pods can be ignored. Open them one at a time to avoid multiple enemies from overwhelming the group.
The boss has a knockdown combo that can pin you down.
Regrow the bridge by collecting items marked in red on the map. One of the items is found after killing a boss underwater.
Once all the item objectives are found talk to the NPC to regrow the bridge.
Boss summons exploding spiders which leave poison aoe. Boss occasionally fears people.
If you get transformed into a kitten, kill a nightmare pup to turn back.
Open pods with icons over them. Kill the enemy and toss the essence at the Husk.

If your team can't cleave them all down, you can focus and pick a person off. Slap Faolain hard when she attempts to revive them. Eir is ranged and can be projectile reflected. Rytlock and Logan can be picked off with ranged attacks. Zojja's orb attack can be easily sidestepped.
